hook: Ab Gemini aapke liye khud ride book karega.

beats.narration: Ab Gemini aapke liye khud ride book karega.
November 2026 mein Google ne India mein Gemini ke multi-step tasks launch kiye.
beats.claim: Multi-step tasks became available in India, Japan and the UK in Google's November 2026 Pixel Drop.

beats.narration: Aap bas bolo. Grocery order, ride booking, khaana order ya restaurant reservation, steps Gemini khud karta hai.
beats.claim: Gemini can carry out multi-step requests such as ordering groceries, booking a ride, ordering takeout or making a restaurant reservation.

beats.narration: Abhi ye Pixel 10, Motorola Signature 27 aur kuch Samsung Galaxy phones pe aa raha hai.
beats.claim: Task automation supports Pixel 10, Motorola Signature 27 and select Samsung Galaxy models.

beats.narration: Android 17 wale select phones pe aap Gemini se storage clear karwa sakte ho, ya location permissions check karwa sakte ho.
beats.claim: Device Assistance on select Android 17+ devices handles tasks such as clearing storage and checking location permissions.

beats.narration: Dhyan rahe, kuch features ke liye age, language ya subscription ki shart hai.
beats.claim: Some features require users to meet age, language and subscription requirements.

beats.narration: Chat se aage, ab AI aapke phone pe kaam karta hai. Aapke phone pe aaya kya?

title: Ab Gemini aapke liye khud ride book karega
description: Gemini multi-step tasks ab India mein: grocery, ride, food, reservation. Pixel 10, Motorola Signature 27 aur select Samsung phones. Nov 2026.
